dependencies.required_input: Purchased 7×7 mm input plus specialist process release
dependencies.guard: Do not treat a generic silicon tile as equivalent; dimensions/material identity alone do not qualify doping or contacts

dependencies.required_input: Distinct electrical regions of one chip,118 parallel elements each
dependencies.guard: Do not split into two physical independent-chip samples; no bare on-chip pad manipulation by robot

dependencies.required_input: 200 micrometre-wide rectangular reference with qualified voltage terminals
dependencies.guard: Indirect density/mobility proxy only for arrays; not an independently manufactured validation sample

dependencies.required_input: Calibrated resistance and historical drift, oil-bath stability
dependencies.lineage: resistor asset ID→calibration revision→bath ID→load/time series
dependencies.guard: A historical paper value is not a calibration certificate for a new resistor

dependencies.lineage: resistor asset ID→calibration revision→bath ID→load/time series
dependencies.guard: Separate from on-chip Hall bar, despite similar nominal resistance; separate from 100-ohm reference bath

dependencies.required_input: Calibrated CCC, current source, nanovoltmeter, thermometer and field measurement
dependencies.guard: One hardware setup may span several logical station roles; exclusive lease required

dependencies.required_input: Qualified ESD, nonmagnetic protected handling; approved condition/storage history
dependencies.guard: No inferred robot grasp, pad-contact or magnetic clearance from source micrograph

dependencies.required_input: Directed ratio definitions; validated Allan/statistical method and covariance
dependencies.guard: No hidden synthetic result, digitized trace, automatic fit-to-paper or source equation patch

preparation_boundary: No chemical procurement, hazardous process action, hardware use or provider communication occurred. Supplier and fabrication service names in the source are historical facts, not endorsed/selected providers.
